verdict.rationale: Body text was extracted from several comptroller.texas.gov guidance pages (file-pay, franchise filing requirements, open-data, homepage), which shows the public reading surface serves readable HTML rather than a JS-only shell or challenge page. The keyless probes got ordinary HTTP responses (404s for absent paths, 200 at the mycpa host redirecting to the front door) rather than 403/503 bot-wall interstitials, and the affiliated open-data rail answered a keyless GET with 200 JSON. missing for 10: an explicit probe of a guidance page recording HTTP 200 with a named identified user agent, robots.txt status for comptroller.texas.gov, and direct confirmation that no CAPTCHA or bot-management challenge is ever served.
